question: What is the full form of HYV seeds that were essential in the implementation of the green revolution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**High Yielding Variety seeds**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ICAR stands for Indian Council of Agricultural Research.
 
• ICAR is the main organization responsible for coordinating agricultural education and research in India.
 
• The Green Revolution in India, which began in the 1960s, was aimed at increasing food grain production, especially in wheat and rice.
 
• Key strategies of the Green Revolution included the use of high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds, chemical fertilizers, and advanced irrigation techniques.
 
• The initiative significantly increased agricultural productivity and self-sufficiency in food grains in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The International Crops Research Institute for the Semi-Arid Tropics (ICRISAT) also played a role in developing crop varieties suitable for India's semi-arid regions.
 
• The Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI), under ICAR, was instrumental in developing high-yielding varieties of wheat.
 
• The success of the Green Revolution led to increased focus on agricultural research and development, paving the way for future advancements in the sector.
